verdict.archive: Archive, checked when it is imported
verdict.archive-empty: The archive holds no ROM file.
verdict.fan-translation: This is the {language, select, es {Spanish} pl {Polish} pt {Portuguese} en-redux {English Redux} nl {Dutch} sv {Swedish} other {fan}} fan translation, which is a language, not a game ROM. Import it as a language: Languages > New language > Fan-patched ROM.
verdict.not-official: Not an official ROM (SHA-1 {hash}). Use one from the list below.
verdict.patched-bad-size: This file is {bytes} bytes, which is not the size of an A Link to the Past ROM.
verdict.unsupported: {name} is an official ROM, but it is not supported yet.
verdict.wrong-kind: This is {name} ({kind, select, snes-alttp {base cartridge} gba-alttp {second cartridge} other {?}}). Expected: {expected, select, snes-alttp {base cartridge} gba-alttp {second cartridge} other {?}}.
refusal.unknown: Not a recognised {label} (SHA-1 {hash}). Only the supported revision can be used.
refusal.invalid: File is not a valid {label} or archive
